lines.en: We may only get one chance to catch this thing,
so we have to play it smart.
You two flank the left, I'll flank the right,
- I got him. - Task Force, engage!
- He's got it. - I got him.
- He's good. - Come on, you cowards!
It's him! It's him, we got him!
- He's the winner. - Okay, okay, okay, okay.
It's all right, it's all right, it's all right.
- Oh, thank you, I had a great task force.
I was just a simple mastermind
This is Andy Dwyer, he actually caught the thing.
- Please, my friends call me Andy Radical.
- By day, Andy Dwyer, shoe shinest.
By different time of day, Andy Radical, possum tackler.
And by night, I do whatever I want, no job.
- We think that this is a great PR opportunity,
so we've arranged for a reporter from the journal
to stop by to interview, get some pictures of the team.
- And next time you need a special favor
from the mayor's office, give me a call.
I need so many special favors.
- Well, you don't have to choose, right?
- How about an extra recycling can?
What time do you usually go to sleep?
'Cause my best ideas usually come to me at night.
- Let's stick to business hours, shall we?
- Am I sure the possum we caught is Fairway Frank?
If it wasn't Fairway Frank, would I feel badly?
As a city official, it's important that I ask myself a lot of questions.
Does doing so help me make decisions?
